# Lumosity

> > Lumosity is a brain training platform offering scientifically-designed cognitive games that challenge memory, attention, flexibility, speed, and problem-solving skills.

Developed by Lumos Labs, Lumosity provides a personalized training program with games like Playing Koi, Star Search, Train of Thought, and Memory Match that target specific cognitive abilities. The platform includes the Human Cognition Project (HCP) for research collaboration and offers content in multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Korean.

## Key Topics

- Brain training and cognitive enhancement
- Working memory exercises
- Divided attention challenges
- Task switching and cognitive flexibility
- Processing speed and reaction time
- Attention games and focus training
- Memory games (short-term and working memory)
- Math and problem-solving puzzles
- Visual tracking and spatial reasoning
- Response inhibition training
- Multitasking abilities
- Human Cognition Project (HCP) research
- Personalized cognitive training programs
- Scientific approach to brain fitness

## Brain Games by Category

- [Attention Games by Lumosity | Challenge Your Focus](https://www.lumosity.com/ko/brain-games/attention-games): Collection of attention games for focus training & distraction filtering
- [Math Games by Lumosity | Solve Fun Math Puzzles](https://www.lumosity.com/ko/brain-games/math-games): Collection of math games for mental calculation & estimation practice

## Memory Training Games

- [Recuerda rápido extremo | Pon a prueba tu memoria de trabajo](https://www.lumosity.com/es/brain-games/memory-match-overdrive): Memory Match Overdrive game tests working memory with advanced challenges
- [Hotel Memoria | Pon a prueba tu memoria de trabajo](https://www.lumosity.com/es/brain-games/memory-serves): Memory Serves game challenges working memory through delivery tracking

## Attention & Processing Speed Games

- [鯉の池 | 分割的注意力に挑戦](https://www.lumosity.com/ja/brain-games/playing-koi): Playing Koi brain game challenges divided attention & visual tracking
- [危険なハイウェイ | 処理スピードに挑戦](https://www.lumosity.com/ja/brain-games/highway-hazards): Highway Hazards game challenges processing speed & reaction time
- [스피드 바리스타 | 분할 주의력을 도전하세요](https://www.lumosity.com/ko/brain-games/trouble-brewing): Speed Barista game tests divided attention & multitasking abilities
- [Construcción de altura | Desafía tu campo de visión](https://www.lumosity.com/es/brain-games/skyrise): Skyrise game trains field of vision & rapid visual perception

## Cognitive Flexibility & Problem Solving Games

- [カラーマッチ | 応答阻害を練習](https://www.lumosity.com/ja/brain-games/color-match): Color Match game trains response inhibition & cognitive flexibility
- [Brain Shift | Entraînez vos compétences de changement de tâche](https://www.lumosity.com/fr/brain-games/brain-shift): Brain Shift game trains task switching & cognitive flexibility
- [Wachsende Logik | Trainiere logisches Denken](https://www.lumosity.com/de/brain-games/organic-order): Organic Order puzzle game trains logical reasoning & sequencing skills
- [Rotation Matrix](https://www.lumosity.com/en/brain-games/rotation-matrix): Rotation Matrix challenges spatial rotation & working memory skills

## Research & Insights
